camel_example: aliyun hbr UninstallBackupClients --region cn-hangzhou --CrossAccountUserId 129349237 --CrossAccountRoleName BackupRole --CrossAccountType CROSS_ACCOUNT --InstanceIds '{}' --ClientIds '{}'
description_en: Uninstalls the backup client from one or more ECS instances
description_zh: 为一台或者多台ECS实例卸载备份客户端
kebab_example: aliyun hbr uninstall-backup-clients --instance-ids '{}' --client-ids '{}' --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --cross-account-user-id 129349237 --cross-account-role-name BackupRole --region cn-hangzhou
name: UninstallBackupClients

parameters.help_en: The ECS instance IDs. You can specify up to 20 instance IDs
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the backup clients. The total number of client IDs and ECS instance IDs cannot exceed 20. Otherwise, an error is reported
parameters.help_zh: 备份客户端ID。客户端ID与ECS实例ID的数量之和不能超过20个，否则报错
parameters.name: client_ids

parameters.help_en:
The cross-account backup type. Valid values: 
SELF_ACCOUNT: backup within the current account
CROSS_ACCOUNT: cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source account used for the cross-account backup feature
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份功能中的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the role created in Resource Access Management (RAM) of the source account for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

ErrorCode.description_en:
The returned error code. Valid values:
Empty: The request is successful.
InstanceNotExists: The ECS instance does not exist.
InstanceNotRunning: The ECS instance is not in the Running state.
CloudAssistNotRunningOnInstance: Cloud Assistant is unavailable
ErrorCode.description_zh:
返回错误码。取值范围：

空表示成功。
InstanceNotExists表示ECS实例不存在。
InstanceNotRunning表示ECS实例未处于Running状态。
CloudAssistNotRunningOnInstance表示云助手不可用

ValidInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup client can be installed on the ECS instance. Valid values:
true: The backup client can be installed.
false: The backup client cannot be installed
ValidInstance.description_zh:
ECS实例是否可以安装备份客户端。

true表示可以安装。
false表示不可以安装

Message.description_en: The returned message. successful is returned if the request is successful. If an error occurs, the corresponding error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task. You can call the DescribeTask operation to obtain the task result
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID。可以调用DescribeTask获取任务结果
